summary: The live controller and eight-worker capacity were healthy, but guide acquisition occupied 236 of 240 sampled worker states. The 1.67% learner duty cycle implies roughly 8.0 days for one 122,880-transition trial at the measured 10.64 total transitions/second. The run was deliberately stopped before its first PPO update, so EXP-0023 is operationally inconclusive rather than a rejection of phase-3 learning or Reward V5. The next experiment retains the same source and V5 but trains from the full untouched boss start, making every action an on-policy learner transition.
